name: Make a Fountain, My Chest
source:
There are two things I need you to know.

The first is that, no matter what you think happens, this is not a ghost story.

The second is that, however scattershot my brain might be, I know that parts of what I'm about to tell you are real.

[From [url=https://skyshard.itch.io/make-a-fountain-my-chest]Itch.io[/url]]
